AgentCompass v0.3.7 calibrates model scores and ability floors from public benchmarks, adds a usage-aware routing simulation, keeps frontier work on frontier models without silent downgrades, and adds an ability-floor chart to the tray.

- **Evidence-calibrated model scores**: Model rows without a measurement are scored from LMArena first (WebDev and Agent boards, fitted to the anchor tiers), then Artificial Analysis or task benchmarks; rows that still have no measurement carry `score_estimated`. Effort curves are recalibrated from Artificial Analysis effort data. A free-usage bonus is declared per account in public data (Dot only) instead of applying to every free model.
- **Ability floors from evidence**: The routine, hard and coupled floors (2.3 / 3.1 / 3.6) come from SWE-bench Verified success by fix-time bucket, cross-checked against LMArena Agent sessions. The tool-execution route has its own hard floor (2.7). Cheap models get the simple work they handle, and the floors are validated on stranger account sets, not just this machine.
- **Frontier work stays on frontier models**: The frontier floor is 4.2 (GPT-6 Astra's anchor tier), so each vendor's top subscription model qualifies. Critical frontier work needs 4.3. When nothing at or above the floor has quota, the plan waits or asks the user (`next_reset`) rather than routing to a lower tier. Models whose harness cannot set an effort declare `fixed_effort` (Grok Bot scores at Medium).
- **Usage-aware routing simulation (`route_simulation.py`)**: `grid`, `explain` and `replay` feed usage through the same pipeline `roll` uses, sweeping usage states (ample, each family scarce, 5h-only, stale), `machine` vs `fresh` modes, and stranger account sets (Claude Pro, Codex Plus/Pro, Antigravity, Magpie pool, OpenCode free).
- **Pool demand fix**: A Magpie pool of N subscriptions forecasts demand against N x 100% and uses the later reset, so a pool no longer looks free when its remaining exceeds one account's allowance.
- **Tray ability-floor chart**: The strategy page shows every model's ability at each effort against the floors, the route floors and the critical gates. Floors can be dragged or typed, with a live preview of which models gain or lose eligibility. Changes are saved as numbers only to `accounts-override.json`, and "restore defaults" removes them.
- **Release verification F10**: The foreign-machine harness verifies all of the above from the installed wheel. Each check is shown to fail against broken data.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.3.7/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Customize the reference fleet and model calibration for your own subscriptions.
